contentText:
Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas” continues her reign on top for a 15th week along with two other entries, newcomer Stella Lefty maintains her top thee slot with her viral hit, “Boston” and pop girls Taylor Swift, Ariana Grande and Olivia Dean help fill out the rest of the top 10.

Tetris Kelly: History is being made on the charts. This is the Billboard Hot 100 top 10 for the week dated Aug. 1. Locked at 10 is “I Just Might.” “Man I Need” slips to nine, as does “Be Her” to No. 8. “So Easy (to Fall in Love)” is up to seven, while “Dracula” falls to six, and Ariana Grande to No. 5. Ella and Morgan rise to four. Stella Lefty grabs a new No. 3. Taylor Swift is still at two. And eclipsing Whitney and Mariah for the longest leading solo female non-holiday No. 1 is Ella Langley.
